deviations: DS1-005: did NOT execute failure_path (would require inventing an action language the spec does not define). Instead the contract's declared failure_path is now read at dispatch and recorded in the tamper-evident Dispatch event (advisory). Documented in the EventPayload::Dispatch field docs.

DS2-003: chose the random-suffix fix over demoting collisions to per-task Fail. Rationale: demotion leaves the task permanently DoS-able by an active worker that chases deterministic IDs wave to wave; unpredictability kills the prediction vector. The frozen signature `workspace_id(task_id, attempt) -> String` is unchanged; only create_workspace's output ID gains the suffix.
DS2-005: documented as known residual only, per brief (no fix attempted).

findings_addressed.DS1-001: HIGH. FIX-1 Layer 1 defeated by worker git-commit. Repair: driver pins the baseline commit hash at dispatch (rev-parse HEAD after the PROMPT.md commit); scope check now diffs `git diff <baseline> HEAD --name-status` (new workspace_committed_paths) UNION `git status --porcelain` (new workspace_footprint). Worker commits show as divergence from baseline. Proven by new test scope_worker_commit_of_stray_fails_gate; in-scope commits still pass.
findings_addressed.DS1-002: MEDIUM. Quarantine path bypassed scope; per-wave rebaselining grandfathered plants. Repair: (a) quarantine loop now calls scope_gate for quarantined tasks before failing the gate; (b) outbox/root snapshots taken ONCE before the first dispatch, driver envelope names accumulate across waves in envelope_names (no per-wave rebaseline); (c) every quarantine appends a chained EventPayload::ReceiptRejected event. Proven by quarantine_logs_rejection_and_scope_checks_plant (wave-1 plant flagged in wave 2).
findings_addressed.DS1-003: MEDIUM. Scope denials invisible in report. Repair: TaskOutcome gains scope_violations: Vec<String>, populated from the latest scope check (cleared on a clean re-check). A confinement escape no longer looks like a test failure.
findings_addressed.DS1-004: MEDIUM. Quarantine invisible in event log. Repair: new EventPayload::ReceiptRejected { cause } appended in the quarantine loop (chained, tamper-evident).
findings_addressed.DS1-005: MEDIUM (assessed). failure_path was write-only. It is Option<String> (optional, not required, contrary to the finding's premise). Repair: read at dispatch, recorded in EventPayload::Dispatch.failure_path as advisory context. Execution deliberately not implemented — no action language exists for it.
findings_addressed.DS2-002: LOW. Worker-controlled artifact_digests[0] (up to 8 MiB) flowed uncapped into events.jsonl. Repair: capped_artifact_digest truncates to MAX_EVENT_DIGEST_CHARS=256 chars at a char boundary before the Response event. Full value stays in the receipt file for forensics.
findings_addressed.DS2-003: LOW (proven live). Workspace-path squatting DoS via predictable {task}-a{attempt} IDs. Repair: create_workspace appends 16 hex chars of /dev/urandom to the ID (format {task}-a{attempt}-<hex>); fail-closed if OS randomness is unavailable. Branch/path-exists Conflict guards remain as defense in depth. workspace_id() frozen signature and deterministic prefix unchanged.

integrator_notes: Frozen interface: Workspace::workspace_id signature AND output unchanged (workspace_id_format_is_stable still passes). Only create_workspace's Workspace.id output changed (added random suffix). workspace.rs test rejects_duplicate_branch_and_path replaced by same_task_attempt_gets_unique_ids (same (task,attempt) now yields distinct IDs by design).
TaskOutcome gained a required field scope_violations: Vec<String> — any other constructors (none in-tree besides the report builder) must set it.

EventPayload gained variant ReceiptRejected { cause } and Dispatch gained field failure_path: Option<String> — 2 constructors updated (driver dispatch site, events.rs roundtrip test). No exhaustive matches in-tree.
Behavior change: outbox/root snapshots once per run (not per wave); envelope names accumulate. A plant from any wave is flagged in every later wave until removed.
scope_gate is shared by the receipt-gating path and the quarantine path; Deny events + report records handled inside.

Test-count note: 8 new #[test] functions added (699 -> 707 attrs); suite executed 747 passed vs I7's 740 (naive base+8 = 748, off by one — unexplained counting quirk, zero failures; all new tests verified passing by name).
known_residuals: DS2-005 (INFO): events.jsonl deletion between runs silently drops history — verify-on-load cannot distinguish 'deleted' from 'never existed' without an external anchor. Not fixed: any in-band fix (e.g. a sentinel file) is deletable by the same actor that can delete the log. Fixing it requires an external append-only anchor (ledger/notary), which is outside the driver's scope. Recorded here as a known residual.
DS1-006 (policy_digest naming), DS1-007 (verdicts/ allowlist), DS1-008 (scope-after-verifier ordering), DS1-009 (no escalation on scope deny) were out of the FIX-5 brief and are NOT addressed.
RT2-005/007/010 remain open by design (release-path wiring, worker network restrictions).
